title: Jurassic Park Gates Reopened
description: A mod that aims to create an accurate and vanilla friendly Jurassic Park in Minecraft!
body:
Life found a way, This mod aims to recreate Jurassic Park and Prehistoric life featured in the Jurassic Franchise, With 12 prehistoric mobs currently ingame, Mobs spawn naturally and you will soon be able to engineer them using multiple machines, 

![Stegositting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57df3f0b355b710f855c0678c81119c179d7b827.png)
